notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Stuffy Doll.
Stuffy Doll does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Stuffy Doll by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Stuffy Doll and Druid's Call trigger.
Resolve the Stuffy Doll trigger, dealing 1 damage to the chosen player.
Resolve the Druid's Call trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
